messages:
dana: deploy-bot flagged a canary error on eu-west1 embeddings (503 spike). Need hotfix and expedited sign-off. TL;DR: kv-cache runner regressed in staging -> canary.

deploy-bot: ALERT: canary failure on service=embeddings eu-west1. metric=503_rate went from 0.2% -> 8.6% in last 3m. Auto-rollback prepared but waiting for manual override. Run: /deploy status canary-8432

ben: oncall here. what's the proposed change? do we have a quick revert or a patch?

alice: patch is a one-line null-check and a kv cache flush. PR #4578 cherry-picks commit d1e9f4a. Verified on staging (smoke ok).

charu: we should prefer rolling pin to older build (v2.3.6) vs hotfix build (v2.3.8-hotfix). Faster to pin back? risk: cache migration differences.

dana: ops asks to pin to v2.3.6 for immediate mitigation. But hotfix v2.3.8 fixes a race; staging smoke passed 2/2. I prefer hotfix but need approvals for expedited window.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Start expedited window? @alice @ben @charu react :pray: to approve immediate deploy. Command to start: /deploy expedite --thread 6098765432

ben: I approve. :thumbsup: can we limit to 10% traffic and force canary duration 5m?

alice: agree to 10% canary, 5m observation, manual rollback trigger if 503_rate > 2% or latency p95 > 800ms. I'll push release notes and pin.

charu: ack. Logging: in release notes include rollback command and contact list. Also add `kv_cache.flush()` runbook step.

dana: ok starting: will run `/deploy promote v2.3.8-hotfix --region eu-west1 --percent 10 --observe 300s` in 1min. @oncall-mike on standby for rollback.

oncall-mike: oncall here. Standby. If we see >2% 503s will flip rollback. I'll watch SLOs and db connections.

deploy-bot: deploybot: executing promote... logs:
```
PROMOTE job id: promote-9921
target: embeddings-eu-west1 v2.3.8-hotfix
traffic: 10%
state: in-progress
```

alice: started smoke checks: sample queries ok. tagging release note snippet:
```
Fix: kv cache null deref causing rare 503s under burst load.
SHA: d1e9f4a
Mitigation: deploy v2.3.8-hotfix (canary 10%)
Rollback: /deploy rollback promote-9921 OR /deploy promote v2.3.6
```

ben: observability: 1m in, 503s at 0.9%, p95 412ms. continuing.

dana: 2m in: 503s 1.8% — borderline. keep watching, do not escalate yet.

oncall-mike: 3m: 503s 3.1% going over threshold. i'm going to pause rollout and initiate rollback if no improvement in 30s.

charu: i vote rollback. :no_good: 

dana: pausing now. @deploy-bot cancel promotion or rollback? /deploy pause promote-9921

deploy-bot: deploybot: Received pause. Pausing traffic shift. Current traffic pinned at 8%. To rollback run `/deploy rollback promote-9921`

dana: I am running rollback now: `/deploy rollback promote-9921 --force`

deploy-bot: deploybot: Rollback started...
```
rollback job id: rb-1122
target: embeddings-eu-west1 -> v2.3.6
state: in-progress
```

alice: after rollback, will run a cache flush and schedule hotfix queue for next maintenance window. logging incident: INC-20260321-42

ben: confirming rollback completed. metrics back to baseline. good call.

oncall-mike: SLOs restored. will follow up with incident doc and timeline.

dana: thanks team. action items: (1) schedule hotfix in maintenance window with pre-warm and KV flush; (2) add automated canary rollback threshold to 2% for embeddings; (3) update release playbook. I'll file PRs.

charu: adding notes to the changelog and alert policy. Closing thread.
